points.quote: Desktop starts from `workbench.desktop.main.ts` ... Desktop-only features, such as native terminals, are imported only from the desktop entry.
web from `workbench.web.main.ts` ... Web-only services are imported only from the web entry.
Each imports the shared `workbench.common.main.ts`, then its own list of services and contributions.
Platform differences sit behind service interfaces. A service is declared as an interface plus a decorator in `common` or `browser`. Each platform then registers its own implementation
Anything not imported (transitively) from an entry point is never bundled or run.
